column1: # Substitutions the ARTIC v5.4.2 spike-in primers are designed against, derived by
# comparing each new primer to Wuhan-Hu-1 (MN908947.3) at its own coordinates.
# Every one of these sits UNDER a primer-binding site, so after ivar trim removes the
# primer the position has no coverage from its own amplicon. It must be recovered from
# the overlapping neighbour, which is the property the round-trip test pins:
#   3564  -> under amplicon 11 primer, recovered from amplicon 12 insert
#   21710 -> under amplicon 69 primer, recovered from amplicon 70 insert
#   21717 -> under amplicon 69 primer, recovered from amplicon 70 insert
#   21940 -> under amplicon 70 primer, recovered from amplicon 71 insert
#   22769 -> under amplicon 74 primer, recovered from amplicon 73 insert
# Applying all five at once makes a genome no real lineage carries: 21710 and 21717
# sit under the SAME amplicon-69 primer, and v5.4.2's two spike-ins there are
# alternates for one or the other, never both. That is harmless and deliberate here,
# because this fixture exists to stress variant RECOVERY and the round-trip test
# amplifies every amplicon unconditionally. It is not harmless for a dropout test,
# which needs one scenario per independent mutation -- see dropout-scenarios.tsv.
